summary: Locked MVP as async same-seed ghost race (not live): host records, invite link, challenger races ghost in shared multiplayer MatchState with shared lead-based lava. Win = first to RACE_GOAL_M=100m; if both die earlier, higher peakY (host/slot0 on tie). Auth optional for play; no race writes to free solo leaderboard. Spec in loop/spec-two-player-race.md (+ loop/spec.md). Flows F-1…F-5, AC-1…AC-21.
goal: Two players race each other on the same climb map (same seed/tower). Define finish rules, live vs async, and ship the smallest coherent head-to-head race mode that fits The Climb.

learnings.insight: MVP race is async ghost on one MatchState (mode multiplayer): host input log drives ghost; live challenger; shared seed and shared lead-based lava. Live realtime is Future; ghost is also the named fallback if live is ever blocked.
learnings.action: Design race invite payload (distinct from ?r= replay) and wire createMatch/stepMatch for two players; do not add WebSocket infra in this MVP.

learnings.insight: resolveOutcome today only crowns status=finished or sets winnerId=null when all eliminated. Solo endless never finishes at a height; race needs first-to-100m finishers plus peakY fallback when both die below goal.
learnings.action: Extend race outcome rules so AC-11/AC-12 hold: finished at ≥100m wins; else higher peakY; equal peak → slot 0 (host). Prove with simulateFromInputs, not source greps.

learnings.insight: Product decision for race: outcomes must not write free solo peakY / topFreeClimbers. Solo free-leaderboard server-re-sim question stays OPEN and is not closed by this MVP.
learnings.action: Keep POST /api/climb/result solo-only; reject any raceWin-style claim; if a race-result API is added later, require auth + server re-sim of both logs before persist.

learnings.insight: Race a friend must open a playable race-create surface (rules + Start recording), not #free teaser — same nav-honesty rule that fixed Free climb → /play.
learnings.action: Walk F-1 in QA: CTA from /play or post-run overlay lands on Start recording; invalid invite recovers to Free climb / Create race without auto-starting solo replay.

learnings.insight: Locked constants: primary mode=async ghost race; RACE_GOAL_M=100; lava=shared lead-based; invite=link only; auth=anonymous play OK; persistent race ladder=out of scope.
learnings.action: Architect and QA treat RACE_GOAL_M=100 and AC-1…AC-21 in loop/spec-two-player-race.md as the contract for this goal.
